subject: Application Outcome - Texas AI Trade Mission - Department for Business and Trade
text:
Hi Leo and Shreya,

I hope this email finds you well. Thank you for your application for the Department for Business and Trade’s Texas AI Trade Mission, and for your patience during our review process.

Unfortunately, Encord narrowly missed out on a spot as part of our ten-company delegation, which we selected from over eighty applicants. As I hope has been clear from Encord’s inclusion in our business matching programme with Cisco earlier
 this month, we are eager to support your growth and international expansion going forwards. Our team has identified Encord as one of the UK’s top 100 AI companies, and are
eager to put in a call with you in the new year to understand your objectives, and how we can support Encord’s growth overseas. Do let me know if this is of interest, and I’ll put in some time with you, me and an AI technology specialist from our team
 to discuss.

Regarding other opportunities in Texas for March 2026, I wanted to share that our partners at Oury Clark are running their
Texas Trade Catalyst 2026 from Sunday 8th – Saturday 14th March, 2026. The deadline to register your interest is
December 22nd.

I hope you both have a restful Christmas break.

Best,

Rohin

subject: Re: Covera Health <> Encord demo @ Tue, 16 Dec 2025 2:00pm – 2:30pm (GMT+00)
text:
Hi Kat, 

It was a pleasure meeting you as well. 

This is our list of requirements for the viewer and demo:

• 

The demo environment must provide a working list containing a minimum of 4 CT or MR studies.

• 

The working list must include at least one study that contains multiple DICOM series.

• 

Every study in the working list must contain a corresponding written report and associated DICOM images.

• 

The viewer must provide a user interface element that allows viewing the report and the image set for a single study.

• 

The viewer must allow the user to easily switch between the report view and the image view for a single study.

• 

Text spanning:

• 

The viewer must accept a list of pre-selected text spans (from a DB/CSV) for a given report.

• 

The viewer must visually highlight the accepted text spans within the displayed report.

• 

Report annotation capabilities. We have two use-cases (modes). One, to support R&D, which requires complex annotation. The other, to support the production pipeline with simpler annotations. 

• 

Production:

• 

Used to double read cases in our production 

• 

Supports multi-task classification where up to 5 tasks are displayed concurrently, with each task having up to 8 class options.

• 

R&D:

• 

Used to support model development. Requires more complicated menus.

• 

Supports point annotation on images. 

• 

The viewer must support sub and sub-sub conditions. For example, the demo should enable the following scenario: 3 conditions, each with 4 sub-options, and each sub-option with 3 sub-sub-options.

• 

Priors: The working list must include at least one study that has an associated prior exam. The viewer must provide a mechanism to view the current study and its associated prior exam.

Please share your availability for the January demo. Do not hesitate to contact us if you have any questions. 

Happy new year!

Micha

-- 

Micha Kornreich, PhD

Senior Vice President, AI

Covera Health
